source: ដំណាំទុរេន (Durian Cultivation), Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, Department of Agricultural Extension, 2015, 31pp
text: This source describes a staged NPK fertilizer program broadly consistent with Source A: an early balanced formula such as 18-18-18 to support general vegetative growth in young trees, transitioning as the tree matures toward fruiting to a formula higher in potassium and magnesium, such as 16-16-17 with added magnesium oxide (MgO), to support flower development and fruit quality. As in Source A, the source stresses timing fertilizer applications around the tree's leaf-flush and flowering cycle rather than on a fixed calendar, since a durian tree's nutrient demand shifts substantially between vegetative flush, flowering, and fruit-fill stages, and applying the wrong nutrient balance at the wrong stage (for example, high nitrogen right before flowering) can suppress flowering or cause fruit drop.
